A. Purpose: To provide guideline instruction for handing patients complains.

B. Scope: Hospital Wide.

C. Policy:

  • Any complaints made by the patient/relatives either in lieu of violation of patient’s rights, provision of medical care etc will be brought into the notice of the Administrator of the hospital either by the patient/relatives directly or by a hospital staff.
  • In case the complaint is made through any hospital staff the Administrator will enquire the authenticity of the same from the particular patient/relative.
  • The Administrator will immediately investigate the complaint either in person or through designated individual staff member/s to find out the authenticity of the complaint, reason for the complaint, staff member responsible (if any).
  • Based on the findings of the investigations appropriate actions will be initiated to resolve the issue and address the patient/relative’s grievance.
  • Written instructions have been displayed in various areas of the hospital encouraging patient/relatives to report any grievance/complain to the Administrator of the hospital.

Policy & Procedure on Feedback Management

A. PURPOSE

To establish a structured system for:

  • Collecting patient and stakeholder feedback
  • Evaluating satisfaction levels
  • Identifying areas for improvement
  • Enhancing quality of care and services

B. SCOPE

This policy applies to:

  • All patients (IPD, OPD, Emergency)
  • Attendants/relatives
  • Visitors and stakeholders
  • All hospital departments

C. POLICY STATEMENT

The hospital is committed to:

  • Encouraging feedback from patients and stakeholders
  • Responding promptly to concerns and suggestions
  • Maintaining confidentiality and transparency
  • Using feedback as a tool for continuous quality improvement

D. DEFINITIONS

  • Feedback: Opinions, comments, suggestions, or complaints regarding hospital services
  • Complaint: Expression of dissatisfaction requiring resolution
  • Suggestion: Input aimed at service improvement
  • Grievance: Formal complaint requiring escalation

E. RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Quality/NABH Coordinator

  • Develop and implement feedback system
  • Analyze feedback data
  • Present reports to management

2. Department Heads

  • Review department-specific feedback
  • Implement corrective actions

3. Front Office / Nursing Staff

  • Facilitate feedback collection
  • Assist patients in filling forms

4. Hospital Administration

  • Ensure timely resolution of complaints
  • Monitor overall patient satisfaction

F. FEEDBACK COLLECTION METHODS

  • Printed feedback forms (IPD/OPD)
  • Digital platforms (tablets, hospital website, apps)
  • Suggestion/complaint boxes
  • Verbal feedback (recorded by staff)
  • Telephonic or email feedback
  • Discharge feedback forms

G. PROCEDURE

1. Collection of Feedback

  • Provide feedback forms at:
    • Admission
    • During stay
    • At discharge
  • Encourage patients/attendants to share honest feedback
  • Assist illiterate or elderly patients

2. Categorization

Feedback is classified into:

  • Compliments
  • Suggestions
  • Complaints/Grievances

3. Recording

  • Assign a unique feedback ID
  • Record in feedback register/software
  • Include:
    • Patient details
    • Department
    • Nature of feedback
    • Date and time

4. Analysis

  • Daily review for critical complaints
  • Monthly trend analysis
  • Identify recurring issues

5. Action & Resolution

  • Immediate action for urgent complaints
  • Assign responsibility to concerned department
  • Define turnaround time (TAT):
    • Minor issues: 24–48 hours
    • Major issues: 3–7 days

6. Communication

  • Inform patient about:
    • Acknowledgement of complaint
    • Actions taken
    • Resolution status

7. Escalation Matrix

  • Level 1: Department Head
  • Level 2: Quality/NABH Coordinator
  • Level 3: Medical Director / Management

8. Closure

  • Confirm resolution with patient
  • Document closure status
  • Maintain records for audit

H. CONFIDENTIALITY

  • Maintain privacy of patient information
  • Ensure anonymous feedback option
  • Restrict access to authorized personnel only
